card.name: Start of the word plasma
card.fires_on: The first piece "pl" (or "PL") of a word that continues as "asma", such as plasma or plasmapheresis. It appears in pharmacology text on blood levels, milk-to-plasma ratios and plasma exchange.

modes.label: Plasma levels
modes.description: The "pl" that begins plasma in drug concentration or lab-value phrases.

modes.label: Plasma exchange
modes.description: The "pl" that begins plasmapheresis or plasma exchange in treatment text.

card.writes: It pushes toward finishing the word as plasma, and it suppresses plasma, serum and similar whole words, which fits a split-word start.
card.plain: It marks the first letters of the word plasma when the word is split into pieces, as in plasma levels or plasmapheresis.
